info.submission: Submit saved candidate-001: fix in xarray/core/indexing.py PandasMultiIndexingAdapter.__array__ — when level is set, default dtype to self.dtype and cast level values with astype(dtype, copy=False) instead of returning raw pandas level values. This prevents int32 (and float32) level coordinates from being upcast by pandas when stacking, so ds['a'].values.dtype == ds.stack(b=('a',))['a'].values.dtype is True.
